title: Case Resolution of 'Western United States'
doc_notes: This document is an AARO case resolution report regarding a UAP sighting in the Western United States in 2021.

incidents.summary: Military personnel reported five equidistant lights in restricted airspace, which were later identified as commercial aircraft.
behavior: flew at a relatively constant pace
incidents.explanation: The objects were commercial aircraft travelling on well-established air corridors up to 300 nautical miles from the sensor.
incidents.quote: Military personnel reported seeing five equidistant lights that they believed represented a potential incursion into restricted military airspace.
